items.addsGrind: Adds {amount} grinds to the equipped weapon.
items.attackSpeed: Attack speed +{percent}%. Attack speed bonuses do not stack; only the highest applies.
items.cellAndroidOnly: Only Android characters can use this evolution item.
items.cellNoAndroid: Android characters cannot use this evolution item.
items.checkSources: See the source page and the drop charts for how to obtain it.
items.combines: Combines with {with} into {result}. The matching level, class and grind requirements also apply.
items.cosmeticEvent: Low chance when opening {via} during the {event}.
items.cosmeticForge: Only obtainable by trading with Montague in the quest The Forge; the required items are listed below.
items.cosmeticShop: Buy it in the quest {quest} for {price} {currency}.
items.disk: Technique disks differ by technique and level; learning one checks base MST and class limits. Most techniques go up to level 30; Anti goes up to 7, and Ryuker and Reverser have no levels. Androids cannot learn techniques.
items.esWeapon: ES weapons come from Challenge Mode, and Paganini can add a special attack; see the source page for the options and costs.
items.givesSkin: Used on a compatible weapon, it changes the weapon’s appearance to {skin}; the weapon’s stats stay the same.
items.grinder: Grinds the equipped weapon; each grind adds 2 ATP, up to the weapon’s max grind.
items.heartFilterOrder: If {weapons} has both a skin and {divine} or {lockon}, the first {neutralizer} removes only the filter and the second removes the skin.
items.heartNeutralizer: {neutralizer} restores the weapon’s original appearance, but the used weapon heart is not returned.
items.heartPhotonFilter: Once {weapons} has the {skin} skin, {filter} changes its colour: it starts {color}, and each use consumes one {filter} and switches to the next colour in a fixed order. It has no effect on other combinations.
items.heartReset: Using it resets the weapon’s grind. The weapon’s name gains a *, and its description shows “Skin: {skin}”.
items.heartUse: Equip a compatible weapon, then use this item from the inventory; compatible weapons are listed below.
items.magCell: Evolves with {cell}. See the acquisition source for the level, class and stat conditions.
items.magNaturalStage4: Natural fourth-stage evolution starts at level 100 and is checked every 10 levels after; the Mag must still be a third-stage Mag that can evolve.
items.magStage3: Level 50 and every 5 levels after; {job}, Section ID: {ids}; {conditions}.
items.magStage3Special: Level 50 and every 5 levels after; FO, DEF ≥ 45; {conditions}.
items.magStage4Excluded: Third-stage evolution rules do not apply to Mags that have already reached the fourth stage.
items.magStats: A Mag’s DEF / POW / DEX / MIND come from how it is fed; its form does not mean fixed stats. The low-HP trigger also requires losing more than 20% of max HP in a single frame and dropping below 10%.
items.makes: Dr. Montague can make this into {item}; the related quest conditions apply.
items.material: Raises character stats. How many can be used is limited by class and material type.
items.musicDisk: Changes the background music of the current area, and other players in the area hear it too. It is single-use; the original music returns when the user leaves the area.
items.obsolete: A retired historical item; it can no longer be obtained or used.
items.paintUse: With {ring} (original or painted) equipped, use it from the inventory to turn the ring {color}.
items.periodicDrainMoving: While moving with it equipped, drains {amount} {stat} every {seconds} sec.
items.periodicRecoverMoving: While moving with it equipped, restores {amount} {stat} every {seconds} sec.
items.platingName: Its name then gains a *, and its description shows “Skin: {skin}”. {common}
items.platingUse: With {ring} equipped, use it from the inventory to change its appearance to {skin}.
items.ringCommon: It performs exactly like a normal {ring}. {redPaint} restores the original look, but the item used is not returned.
items.ringRevert: Used on a painted or re-skinned {ring}*, it restores the original {ring}. Paints or platings already used are not returned.
items.techniqueLevels: Raises learned technique levels by {levels}, up to the class’s technique level cap.
items.variableSpecial: The special attack depends on the individual dropped or shop-generated item; it is not fixed.
items.weaponShop: weapon shop (stock changes with character level)
